title: aggregator(diagnostics): the three 240-char text caps split surrogate pairs — safeProviderReason / sanitizeCollectionError / extractNeedsDrewReason raw-slice at 240

labels.name: kind/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working (prefixed form of the classic bug label)

labels.name: task/small-fix
labels.description: Queue packet kind: bounded fix with reproduction and targeted tests

body:
## Problem

Three aggregator diagnostic-text caps raw-slice at 240 UTF-16 code units, so a surrogate pair straddling the cap is split and a lone high surrogate is emitted into JSON output — the #3178 class that #7694/#7711/#7725/#7731/#7736 fixed in the neighbouring stores with a `capUnits` guard. These three sites were not audited:

- `pm-stack/aggregator/src/credential-lifecycle.ts:39` — `safeProviderReason()` ends in `.slice(0, 240)`. Its output is stored as the credential-lifecycle row `reason` (via `lifecycleForEntry`) and as `entry.error` (`src/quota-gather-map.ts:425`, `src/quota-current.ts:119`), rendered on the board/quota surfaces.
- `pm-stack/aggregator/src/feed.ts:183` — `sanitizeCollectionError()` ends in `.slice(0, 240)`. Its output is persisted as feed section error text (`feedSectionStatus`, and re-sanitized on read in `sanitizeFeedMetadata`) in the shared fleet feed JSON.
- `pm-stack/aggregator/src/needs-drew.ts:108` — `extractNeedsDrewReason()` returns `reason.slice(0, 240)`. The extracted reason is carried on `NeedsDrewItem.reason` (`src/needs-drew.ts:219`) into the attention view.

## Evidence (verified this run, laptop main c748833ab0)

Probe `~/git/fleet/probe-diagnostic-240/probe.ts` (laptop) importing the real modules (md5: feed.ts 72a7c44d9962b9acf4b223cc9f27338c, credential-lifecycle.ts 81782b8eb50fe6d4de5cc09e80bd042f, needs-drew.ts 7ee979a750c00f06b15504400687bf55). Input: 239 units of short words + U+1F600 + tail, so the pair straddles unit 240; control: the same pair ending exactly at unit 240.

```
credential straddle | len: 240 | lone: true | utf8-rt changes: true
credential control  | len: 240 | lone: false | utf8-rt changes: false
feed straddle       | len: 240 | lone: true | utf8-rt changes: true
feed control        | len: 240 | lone: false | utf8-rt changes: false
needsdrew straddle  | len: 240 | lone: true | utf8-rt changes: true
needsdrew control   | len: 240 | lone: false | utf8-rt changes: false
json stored contains lone escape: true
```

Every straddle case ends in a lone `\ud83d`: `JSON.stringify` stores it as the `\ud83d` escape, and a UTF-8 encode/decode round-trip (the feed/board JSON is written to disk and re-read) replaces it with U+FFFD — the provider error, collection error, or escalation reason a human reads is silently corrupted at exactly the truncation point. Exact-fit controls are intact, so this is the cut, not the inputs.

## Why it matters

These strings exist to be read in a failure moment: why a credential is rejected, why a feed section failed to collect, why an item waits on Drew. Corrupting the tail of exactly the longest — usually most detailed — messages hides the diagnostic that matters, and it puts lone-surrogate escapes into JSON files other consumers parse. Same defect class, same fix shape as the five merged predecessors; these are the remaining raw `.slice(0, 240)` text caps in `pm-stack/aggregator/src` (the other remaining slices are dates/hex/slugs over ASCII-safe alphabets, or the event writers already tracked in #7740).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `safeProviderReason`, `sanitizeCollectionError`, and `extractNeedsDrewReason` never return a string ending in a lone surrogate: a pair straddling the 240 cap is dropped whole (result 239 units), mirroring the `capUnits` semantics of #7694.
- [ ] Redaction behaviour is unchanged: all existing credential/token redaction replacements still apply before the cap, and exact-fit strings (pair ending at 240) pass through intact.
- [ ] Regression tests pin all three functions: straddle case drops the pair, exact-fit control intact; the new tests fail on the pre-fix code.
- [ ] Existing suites for the three modules (`credential-lifecycle.test.ts`, `feed.test.ts`, `needs-drew.test.ts`) still pass.
